title: The Case of Victoria Martens

Victoria Martens was a young girl from Albuquerque, NM. When her mom, Michelle Martens, and her boyfriend, Fabian Gonzales, called police saying that their roommate was losing her mind, and they didn't know where Victoria was, a horrifying discovery was made.
